recommendation: Keep the source fix; it completes the applied terminology correction across current authoritative XML-related narrative without reopening the broader signature-scope decision already audited for FHIR-18445.
issue_request: FHIR-18434 was Published with resolution Persuasive and requested that XML format text stop referring to the XML declaration syntax as a processing instruction, using "XML declaration" instead.
initial_application: The original XML page request was applied in git commit 93a1e518122819664527632651511d587a93dad4, and source/xml.html still uses the approved XML declaration wording.
additional_context: A later 2025 rewrite moved current XML canonicalization guidance into source/signatures.html and reintroduced the same terminology error for the required declaration. FHIR-18445's existing combined-branch audit confirms source/signatures.html is the active signature canonicalization location and that the declaration requirement should remain.
reconciliation: Changed source/signatures.html to say "Include the XML declaration" while preserving the required declaration text.
source_changes: source/signatures.html: changed the XML canonicalization rule from "Include the XML processing instruction" to "Include the XML declaration" for <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>.

related_jiras.note: Its existing combined-branch audit establishes that source/signatures.html is active signature canonicalization guidance; this fix preserves that requirement while correcting terminology.
